Frozen before live embeddings. Tuning uses attendance, fees, transport and access families; held_out uses assessment, costume, recording and scholarship families. Shared administrative vocabulary is unavoidable, but policy facts are not duplicated across split families.

Archived 2026 and current 2027 sources are separate documents. Simultaneously active fee, access and costume contradictions are intentional: conflict questions require both statements; retrieval must not resolve authority.

Each split contains 40 answerable, 8 in-period unanswerable and 2 entirely date-excluded cases. Some individual-fact cases are replaced by multi-source evidence questions to test conditions, exceptions and contradictions.
Offsets are Unicode code-point, left-closed/right-open positions into exact UTF-8 decoded source files. Facts in appended final sections test end-of-document evidence.
Unanswerable cases deliberately have no evidence; nearest-neighbour results are not labelled correct simply because their topic resembles the query.
This is a hand-authored challenge corpus, not a random sample of production traffic; passing it is not a production reliability claim.

Corpus size: 131248 source bytes across 16 documents; fixed chunker v1/cl100k_base yields 201 passage records and 199 parent records. Fifteen Markdown sources use realistic section boundaries; scholarship_admin.txt exercises unstructured paragraph splitting.
